name: capability-registry
description: The empirical capability registry contract (W040, the W039 flat source-exported pattern). Spec: REQUIREMENTS.md R052 — 'Capability discovery is EMPIRICAL' — enforced STRUCTURALLY: a capability enters the registry only through a registration gate that demands MEASURED provenance (W037 experiment descriptors re-identified through experimentIdOf + W038 experiment evaluations + W038 findings reports whose digest is re-derived through findingsDigestOf and whose verdict must have PASSED); a label-only entry is a typed loud error naming the law, never silent acceptance. Capabilities are typed DATA: a closed kind/domain vocabulary, the bearer dimension (which W033 substrate or body class demonstrated it), explicit tenant/project/world scope, versioned immutable lineage, and evidence-linked citations of the canonical W037/W038 ids. Deterministic fail-closed queries — by id, by kind/domain, and the W039 demand-matching seam (does a registered capability satisfy a position's declared capability demand? typed yes/no with reasons) plus the organization-offering projection the W039 compiler's registry input is built from. Lifecycle states (registered/deprecated/revoked) transition immutably; a deprecated capability still resolves for lineage but fails demand-matching loudly. A9: same declarations + same citations ⇒ same canonical ids ⇒ deep-equal registry. NO measurement execution, no model calls, no I/O — the registry RECORDS measured provenance; the measuring happened in the W037/W038 artifacts.
